parameters.query:
UPDATE reports SET
  status = $2,
  reviewer = $3,
  approved_at = CASE WHEN $4 = 'approve' THEN now() ELSE approved_at END,
  draft_json = CASE WHEN $5::jsonb IS NOT NULL THEN draft_json || $5::jsonb ELSE draft_json END,
  edit_history = edit_history || $6::jsonb
WHERE id = $1::uuid
RETURNING id, employee_id, status, reviewer, approved_at, edit_history;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ report_id: $json.id, employee_id: $json.employee_id, status: $json.status, reviewer: $json.reviewer, approved_at: $json.approved_at, edit_history: $json.edit_history }) }}
